title: Purple Comet Math Meet — AI-participant non-comparable draft

applicability.notes: Division-specific timing should become a selector when each row carries hs or ms explicitly.

required_roles.title: captain and solver
duties: Coordinate problem allocation, verify answer formatting, and submit the shared answers.

fill_role.title: team solver
duties: Solve assigned problems and communicate exact answers with a checkable derivation.

turn_budget.derivation: The high-school 90-minute clock is represented by a fixed agent-turn budget; middle-school timing requires a separate selector.

internet.conditions: Internet access is limited to the contest platform; do not search for definitions, methods, or solutions.

code_execution.conditions: Computational tools may perform calculations but may not produce, explain, or verify a solution method.

constraints.statement: A team contains one to six students and has an adult supervisor.
Generative AI tools may not produce, explain, or verify answers or code.
constraints.waiver_reason: The benchmark participants are themselves generative AI agents.

constraints.statement: Submit non-negative integer answers through the contest interface.

collaboration.notes: The roster generator supports every official size from one to six rather than only the default six.

submission.adaptation: The contest form is serialized as text.

evaluation.notes: Official answer lists support deterministic scoring.

waivers.official_rule: Generative AI is forbidden from producing, explaining, or verifying answers.
waivers.benchmark_treatment: Generative AI agents solve and explain the problems.

sources.title: Purple Comet official rules
sources.locator: Team size, timing, permitted computation, answer format, and AI prohibition

provenance.notes: The profile is deliberately non-comparable because the participant technology violates an explicit rule.
